name: Pipeline: bokeh depth-of-field (CoC + disc kernel + highlight bloom)
description: The quality core. Per plane: coc = aperture * |planeZ - focusZ|; sample a DISC of radius coc (not gaussian) for bokeh; weight bright samples up so highlights bloom into bokeh discs. Composite planes back-to-front, focal plane sharp, foreground bleeding slightly over the subject. Premultiplied alpha preserved. Deterministic per progress. This is where photorealism lives — invest here.
result: Bokeh DOF composite (ADR-0027 quality core). Composite pass blurs each plane by CoC=aperture·|planeZ−focusZ|·MAX_COC_PX(120) via a flat-disc gather: 48-tap golden-angle spiral, r=sqrt(t) → uniform areal density (hard-edged disc, NOT gaussian); bright taps weighted up (threshold 0.7, strength 2.6) so highlights bloom into bright discs; per-fragment UV-hash angular jitter (frame-deterministic) dissolves tap structure into dither. Planes composite premultiplied back-to-front — focal sharp, defocused bleeds over subject, clean into transparent surround (no halos). Surface plane (focal, CoC 0) stays sharp via the same loop (zero offset). CDP-verified both focus directions on flagged Chrome; circular disc confirmed by rounded corners on a defocused hard-edged card. Tunables (MAX_COC_PX/bloom/taps) are shader consts. 0 type errors, lint+verify-presets green.

name: Converge the 7 surface double-casts into one typed adapter
description: Converge the 7 surface 'as unknown as SurfaceRenderInstance' casts into one typed path. ANALYSIS (2026-06-15): only 2 concrete compositors exist — createPaperPipeline (paper, newspaper) and createPlainPipeline (plain, chapter-card, title-sequence, pullquote-on-photo, type-hero); each index.ts wraps one with the double-cast. Casts exist because SurfaceRenderInstance (types.ts) is too narrow: it lacks getOutputTexture() and its render takes {timestamp} while the compositors take rich inputs. PaperRenderInputs and PlainRenderInputs DIVERGE: PaperAnimState.paperVisibility vs PlainAnimState.bodyVisibility, and Paper has an extra backgroundVisibility. CLEAN FIX: define SurfaceAnimState{markProgresses, surfaceVisibility} + SurfaceRenderInputs{animState, backgroundVisibility?, markColorsByIndex, markIntensityByIndex, textAnimAlphaByMarkIndex?, timestamp} in platform/pipelines/types.ts; add getOutputTexture(): GPUTexture + render(SurfaceRenderInputs) to SurfaceRenderInstance; rename paperVisibility/bodyVisibility -> surfaceVisibility in paper+plain pipeline.ts (update all reads); make buildRenderInputs (Workspace:258) return the unified type so casts at 547/556 drop; the 7 index.ts return createXxxPipeline(opts) directly. ~11 files; svelte-check is the safety net for the renames. Deferred from the long session that did the rest of the hygiene epic — wants a focused pass.
result: Typed adapter landed: SurfaceAnimState + SurfaceRenderInputs in types.ts, getOutputTexture() on SurfaceRenderInstance, 7 double-casts removed, Workspace unified. svelte-check 0 errors.

name: Engine: snapshot a Preset's composite to a cached color texture (ADR-0026)
description: Per ADR-0026 (snapshot-and-wipe). Add the ability to render a referenced Preset's full single-composition through the existing path and capture its composited frame into a cached color texture, at a settled representative frame (default mid-timeline). The transition path captures from -> texA and to -> texB once at load (swap global engine-state, let Svelte flush DOM between, capture), reusing the effect-chain's intermediate-texture machinery. No two-live-DOM/two-engine-state co-render. Verify both snapshots capture the right settled frames before wiring the effect.
result: Snapshot render works. renderCompositeTo seam + TransitionSnapshots textures + captureStateSnapshot (swap engineState to from/to via applyCompositionState, settle DOM at mid-timeline, explicit uploadDom, renderCompositeTo to snapshot texture). Needed extra layout-settle frames for overlay glyphs (text-3d). Verified: both from/to captured correctly. Commit a9ccf12.

name: Multi-state transitions — snapshot-and-wipe (ADR-0022 model, ADR-0026 impl)
description: Activate multi-state transitions. Model+schema per ADR-0022; v1 IMPLEMENTATION per ADR-0026 (snapshot-and-wipe, NOT live dual-tree — the live co-render fights the global-singleton + live-DOM architecture and is deferred). A transition Preset declares top-level transition { from, to, effect, durationMs }; the engine snapshots from and to each once into a cached color texture and the mask-wipe Effect animates a mask over the two static textures. Each piece verified visually via scripts/cdp-capture.mjs. Done when a bumper wipes settled A -> settled B and the Critic confirms a true per-pixel wipe, transparent output.
result: Multi-state transitions shipped (snapshot-and-wipe, ADR-0026). Schema+validation, snapshot render, 2-texture transition lane, mask-wipe shader, verified demo. A transition Preset renders a true per-pixel wipe between two snapshotted states. Commits 0adb881 (schema), 8f744ec (ADR), 3392d64 (seam), a9ccf12 (orchestration+wipe+demo).
